CLIP, Zero-Shot, from the Embeddings Up.src: CLIP, Zero-Shot, from the Embeddings Up

In 2021, OpenAI's CLIP model did somethi.zh: 2021 年，OpenAI 的 CLIP 模型做到了此前任何图像分类器都未能做到的事：它可以判断一张照片究竟是「一只鹦鹉的照片」还是「一块滑板的照片」，@@T0@@而无需在这些类别上进行任何微调@@T1@@。本页在你的浏览器中运行真实的 CLIP-ViT-B/32，把你输入的任意标签与你的照片一同嵌入到共享空间中，并逐步展示每一次余弦相似度与 softmax 计算。
In 2021, OpenAI's CLIP model did somethi.src: In 2021, OpenAI's CLIP model did something no image classifier had done before: it could tell you whether a photo was "a photo of a parrot" or "a photo of a skateboard" without ever being fine-tuned on those classes. This page runs the real CLIP-ViT-B/32 in your browser, embeds whatever labels you type into a shared space with your photo, and shows every cosine similarity and softmax on the way.

A regular image classifier has a fixed o.zh: 普通的图像分类器拥有固定的输出头：1,000 个 ImageNet 类别、80 个 COCO 类别，诸如此类。你无法向它询问「一只正在吃寿司的捕鸟蛛的照片」，因为它没有对应的输出单元。
A regular image classifier has a fixed o.src:
A regular image classifier has a fixed output head: 1,000
          ImageNet classes, 80 COCO classes, whatever. You cannot ask it
          about "a photo of a tarantula eating sushi" because it doesn't
          have that output unit.

CLIP punts on output heads entirely. Ins.zh: CLIP 完全绕开了输出头。它转而训练两个编码器——一个用于图像，一个用于文本——使得相匹配的配对在共享的 512 维向量空间中彼此靠近。在推理时，你把图像编码一次，把任意一组候选标签编码为文本，然后直接选取余弦相似度最接近的那个标签。模型完全不知道你会询问哪些标签；这正是「零样本」的含义所在。
CLIP punts on output heads entirely. Ins.src:
CLIP punts on output heads entirely. Instead, it trains two
          encoders—one for images, one for text—so that
          matching pairs end up close together in a shared 512-dim vector
          space. At inference time, you encode the image once, encode any
          set of candidate labels as text, and just pick whichever label
          is closest in cosine similarity. The model has no idea which
          labels you'll ask about; that's the zero-shot part.

OpenAI trained CLIP on 400 million image.zh: OpenAI 在从网络上抓取的 4 亿个图文对上训练 CLIP，使用的是一种简单的对比损失：在一个大批次内，正确的（图像，标题）配对应具有高相似度，而每一个错误配对应具有低相似度。训练完成后，嵌入空间已足够有意义，以至于@@T0@@任意@@T1@@一条标题都可以作为类别原型。
OpenAI trained CLIP on 400 million image.src: OpenAI trained CLIP on 400 million image-text pairs scraped from the web, with a simple contrastive loss: within a big batch, the correct (image, caption) pair should have high similarity, and every wrong pair should have low similarity. After training, the embedding space is meaningful enough that any caption can act as a class prototype.

Two encoders, one shared space.zh: 两个编码器，一个共享空间

CLIP is not one network. It's two. The v.zh: CLIP 并非单一网络，而是两个网络。视觉编码器是一个 Vision Transformer（或 ResNet，取决于具体变体）；文本编码器是一个小型 Transformer。二者各自把输入映射为单个 512 维向量。所有奇妙之处都发生在这个共享的 512 维空间中。
CLIP is not one network. It's two. The v.src:
CLIP is not one network. It's two. The vision encoder is a
          Vision Transformer (or ResNet, depending on the variant); the
          text encoder is a small Transformer. Each maps its input to
          a single 512-dim vector. That shared 512-dim space is where all
          the magic happens.

Both vectors are $\\ell_2$-normalised af.zh: 两个向量在最终投影后都经过 $\ell_2$ 归一化，因此它们位于单位超球面上。二者之间的距离由余弦相似度度量——等价地，即它们的点积——取值范围从 $-1$（完全相反）到 $+1$（完全相同）。
Both vectors are $\\ell_2$-normalised af.src:
Both vectors are $\ell_2$-normalised after the final projection,
          so they live on the unit hypersphere. Distance between them is
          measured by cosine similarity—equivalently, their dot
          product—and it ranges from $-1$ (opposite) to $+1$
          (identical).

Type whatever you want. CLIP will tokeni.src: Type whatever you want. CLIP will tokenize each label, push the tokens through its text Transformer, and emit another 512-dim vector. These become your class prototypes. Whichever prototype is closest to your image in the shared space wins.

CLIP was trained on captions, not bare c.zh: CLIP 是在标题而非裸类别名称上训练的。把标签包裹进一个自然语调的模板（例如「a photo of a {label}」）通常能得到比单独使用标签好得多的文本向量。切换模板以作比较：

CLIP was trained on captions, not bare class names. Wrapping

One dot product per label. 512 multiplic.zh: 每个标签一次点积。512 次乘法与 511 次加法，再乘以标签数量。这就是 CLIP 中零样本分类的全部开销。
One dot product per label. 512 multiplic.src:
One dot product per label. 512 multiplications and 511
          additions, times the number of labels. That's the entire cost
          of zero-shot classification in CLIP.

@@T0@@Why unit-normalising matters.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@单位归一化为何重要。@@T1@@
          CLIP 训练所用的对比损失奖励匹配配对具有高点积，而非匹配配对的点积较低。若不做归一化，模型可以通过让所有配对的相似度在绝对值上都很大来「作弊」。归一化使每个向量处于同一尺度；相似度只关乎方向。
@@T0@@Why unit-normalising matters.@@T1@.src: Why unit-normalising matters. The contrastive loss CLIP trained with rewards high dot product for matching pairs and low for non-matching. Without normalisation, the model could cheat by making all pairs' similarities big in absolute terms. Normalising puts every vector on the same scale; similarity is only about direction.

To turn similarity scores into probabili.zh: 为把相似度得分转换为概率，我们施加一个 softmax。CLIP 用一个学习得到的温度 $\tau \approx 0.01$ 对 logit 进行缩放（等价地，即乘以 $1/\tau \approx 100$）：
To turn similarity scores into probabili.src:
To turn similarity scores into probabilities we apply a softmax.
          CLIP scales the logits by a learned temperature
          $\tau \approx 0.01$ (equivalently, scales by $1/\tau \approx 100$):

The scaling makes the softmax very sharp.zh: 这种缩放使 softmax 变得非常尖锐。仅 0.05 的相似度差异就能产生 5× 的概率差距。拖动下方的温度滑块以观察效果：$\tau$ 越低，预测越尖锐；$\tau$ 越高，预测越平坦。
The scaling makes the softmax very sharp.src:
The scaling makes the softmax very sharp. A similarity
          difference of just 0.05 can produce a 5× probability
          gap. Slide the temperature below to see the effect: lower
          $\tau$ = sharper predictions; higher $\tau$ = flatter.

CLIP's pretrained temperature is ~0.01..zh: CLIP 预训练的温度约为 0.01。调高它会使置信度变得平坦，调低它则会使其变得陡峭。
CLIP's pretrained temperature is ~0.01..src:
CLIP's pretrained temperature is ~0.01. Raise it to flatten

A model that's never seen your labels no.src: A model that's never seen your labels nonetheless gets them right most of the time. The reason is the scale and diversity of the contrastive pretraining data. CLIP saw 400 million (image, caption) pairs from the open web, which means it saw:

By the end, the image of @@T0@@any@@T1@@.zh: 最终，@@T0@@任意@@T1@@一张猫的图像都与@@T2@@任意@@T3@@一条关于猫的合理标题的文本嵌入相接近。这种预训练为你换来一个出奇通用的「图像到语言」相似度函数，它能迁移到未见过的标签集上。
By the end, the image of @@T0@@any@@T1@@.src: By the end, the image of any cat is close to the text embedding of any plausible caption about cats. The pretraining buys you a surprisingly general image-to-language similarity function that transfers to unseen label sets.

Why the 512-dim head is enough.zh: 为何 512 维的输出头已足够

dimensions in the shared space. That's p.zh: 个维度构成共享空间。这足以容纳数百万个彼此不同的概念，因为嵌入并不需要彼此正交——它们只需按语义相似度@@T0@@聚簇@@T1@@即可。@@T2@@cat@@T3@@、@@T4@@kitten@@T5@@ 与 @@T6@@tabby@@T7@@ 并不争夺坐标轴；它们彼此堆叠在一起。
dimensions in the shared space. That's p.src: dimensions in the shared space. That's plenty of room for millions of distinct concepts because the embeddings don't need to be orthogonal—they just need to cluster by semantic similarity. cat, kitten, and tabby don't fight for axes; they pile on top of each other.

Four places CLIP will fool you.zh: CLIP 会误导你的四个地方
Four places CLIP will fool you.src: Four places CLIP will fool you

@@T0@@\"CLIP understands what it classif.zh:
@@T0@@「CLIP 理解它所分类的东西。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              CLIP 学到的是一个相似度函数，而非真值函数。如果有人把「iPod」这个词贴在一个苹果上，它会毫不犹豫地把那张打印标牌称为「iPod」（@@T3@@排版攻击@@T4@@，Goh 等，2021）。它并不推理；它只做匹配。
@@T0@@\"CLIP understands what it classif.src:
"CLIP understands what it classifies."
CLIP learns a similarity function, not a truth function. It's happy to call a typed sign "iPod" if someone tapes that word to an apple (typographic attack, Goh et al. 2021). It doesn't reason; it matches.

@@T0@@\"Zero-shot means no training.\"@@.zh:
@@T0@@「零样本意味着无需训练。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              有人花了 4 亿个配对以及一个 GPU 集群来训练这些编码器。你免费得到的是@@T3@@对新标签的泛化能力@@T4@@，而不是一顿免费的午餐。
@@T0@@\"Zero-shot means no training.\"@@.src:
"Zero-shot means no training."
Someone spent 400 million pairs and a GPU cluster training the encoders. What you get for free is generalization to new labels, not a free lunch.

@@T0@@\"Adding more labels can only help.zh:
@@T0@@「多加标签只会更好。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              额外的近义标签会分散概率质量，损害任何单个标签的得分。额外的垃圾标签会拉扯 softmax，充当噪声。更多并不总是更好；应选择一个聚焦且彼此区分良好的标签集。
@@T0@@\"Adding more labels can only help.src:
"Adding more labels can only help."
Extra near-synonym labels split probability mass, hurting any single label's score. Extra garbage labels pull the softmax and act as noise. More is not always better; pick a focused, well-separated label set.

@@T0@@\"CLIP is unbiased because it wasn.zh:
@@T0@@「CLIP 没有偏见，因为它不是在标签上训练的。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              它是在从网络上抓取的 4 亿条标题上训练的。网络本身的偏见——性别化的职业印象、种族刻板印象、文化盲点——都被烙印其中。许多论文已对此进行探查；部署时务必谨慎。
@@T0@@\"CLIP is unbiased because it wasn.src:
"CLIP is unbiased because it wasn't trained on labels."
It was trained on 400M captions scraped from the web. The biases of the web—gendered professions, racial stereotypes, cultural blind spots—are baked in. Many papers have probed these; deploy with care.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Z.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          用 CLIP 做零样本分类不过是两次矩阵乘法加上一个 softmax。奇妙之处不在于数学；而在于 4 亿张带标题的图像，它们的结构被蒸馏进了共享嵌入空间。你如今已用自己的照片和自己的标签亲手走过了整条流水线——而所用模型事先确实并不知道你会问什么。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Z.src: Final takeaway. Zero-shot classification with CLIP is two matrix multiplies and a softmax. The magic isn't the math; it's the 400 million captioned images whose structure got distilled into the shared embedding space. You've now done the full pipeline yourself on your own photo with your own labels—on a model that genuinely does not know in advance what you were going to ask.

The contrastive training objective in de.src: The contrastive training objective in detail

CLIP minimises a symmetric InfoNCE loss.zh: CLIP 在图像与文本之间最小化一个对称的 InfoNCE 损失：
CLIP minimises a symmetric InfoNCE loss.src: CLIP minimises a symmetric InfoNCE loss across image and text:

$z_i^I = \\mathrm{img\\_enc}(I_i) / \\|\.zh: $z_i^I = \mathrm{img\_enc}(I_i) / \|\cdot\|_2$ 与 $z_i^T = \mathrm{text\_enc}(T_i) / \|\cdot\|_2$ 是经 L2 归一化的嵌入；$\tau$ 是学习得到的温度（CLIP 中初始化为 $\log(1/0.07)$）。对于一个含 $N$ 个配对的批次，每个 $(I_i, T_i)$ 都是正样本，而其余 $N-1$ 条文本为负样本——对称版本还会把图像视作文本的「标签」。
$z_i^I = \\mathrm{img\\_enc}(I_i) / \\|\.src: $z_i^I = \mathrm{img\_enc}(I_i) / \|\cdot\|_2$ and $z_i^T = \mathrm{text\_enc}(T_i) / \|\cdot\|_2$ are L2-normalised embeddings; $\tau$ is a learned temperature (CLIP's was initialised to $\log(1/0.07)$). For a batch of $N$ pairs, each $(I_i, T_i)$ is the positive while the other $N-1$ texts are negatives — and the symmetric version also treats the image as a "label" for the text.

Two implementation details that mattered.zh: 两个在实践中极其重要的实现细节：
Two implementation details that mattered.src: Two implementation details that mattered enormously in practice:

@@T0@@Huge batch size.@@T1@@ CLIP traine.zh: @@T0@@超大批次。@@T1@@ CLIP 以 32,768 的批次大小训练。负样本越多 ⇒ 对比任务越难 ⇒ 表征越好。没有这一点，损失会迅速饱和。
@@T0@@Huge batch size.@@T1@@ CLIP traine.src: Huge batch size. CLIP trained at batch size 32,768. More negatives ⇒ harder contrastive task ⇒ better representations. Without this, the loss saturates fast.

@@T0@@Image and text encoders are not sy.zh: @@T0@@图像与文本编码器并不对称。@@T1@@ 图像一侧是 ViT 或 ResNet；文本一侧是 12 层 Transformer。正是投影头（编码器之后的线性层）使这两个嵌入空间真正对齐。
@@T0@@Image and text encoders are not sy.src: Image and text encoders are not symmetric. The image side is a ViT or ResNet; the text side is a 12-layer Transformer. The projection heads (post-encoder linear layers) are what make the two embedding spaces actually align.

The CLIP family — what came next.src: The CLIP family — what came next

@@T0@@OpenCLIP (LAION, 2022).@@T1@@ Open.zh: @@T0@@OpenCLIP（LAION，2022）。@@T1@@ 开放权重与开放数据；用 LAION-2B 复现了 CLIP 的性能。
@@T0@@OpenCLIP (LAION, 2022).@@T1@@ Open.src: OpenCLIP (LAION, 2022). Open weights and open data; matched CLIP performance with LAION-2B.

@@T0@@SigLIP (Google, 2023).@@T1@@ Repla.zh: @@T0@@SigLIP（Google，2023）。@@T1@@ 用 sigmoid 损失替代 softmax 交叉熵。与批次大小无关；小批次表现更好。SigLIP-2（2024）进一步扩展到多语言与稠密头。
@@T0@@SigLIP (Google, 2023).@@T1@@ Repla.src: SigLIP (Google, 2023). Replaces the softmax cross-entropy with a sigmoid loss. Independent of batch size; better small-batch behaviour. SigLIP-2 (2024) extends with multilingual + dense heads.

@@T0@@EVA-CLIP, MetaCLIP, DFN-CLIP.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@EVA-CLIP、MetaCLIP、DFN-CLIP。@@T1@@ 规模扩展与数据筛选的变体。编码器更大、数据过滤更好，零样本 ImageNet 准确率高出约 2–5 个点。
@@T0@@EVA-CLIP, MetaCLIP, DFN-CLIP.@@T1@.src: EVA-CLIP, MetaCLIP, DFN-CLIP. Scaling + data-curation variants. Larger encoders, better data filtering, ~2–5 points higher zero-shot ImageNet.

@@T0@@CLIPA.@@T1@@ Cheap CLIP — train at.zh: @@T0@@CLIPA。@@T1@@ 廉价 CLIP——先在较小分辨率 / 词元数下训练，再以全分辨率微调。训练成本降低约 4×。
@@T0@@CLIPA.@@T1@@ Cheap CLIP — train at.src: CLIPA. Cheap CLIP — train at smaller resolution / token count, then fine-tune at full res. Reduces training cost by ~4×.

@@T0@@EVA-02, DINOv2, AIM.@@T1@@ Self-su.zh: @@T0@@EVA-02、DINOv2、AIM。@@T1@@ 不带语言对齐的自监督骨干网络；当下游不需要语言时，常@@T2@@用来替代@@T3@@ CLIP 的图像编码器。
@@T0@@EVA-02, DINOv2, AIM.@@T1@@ Self-su.src: EVA-02, DINOv2, AIM. Self-supervised backbones with no language alignment; often used in place of CLIP's image encoder when language isn't needed downstream.

Prompt engineering for CLIP.zh: 面向 CLIP 的提示工程

The classification accuracy of CLIP depe.zh: CLIP 的分类准确率对提示措辞的依赖程度令人震惊。「cat」得到一种准确率；「a photo of a cat」高出约 5 个点；「a photo of a cat, a type of pet」又更高。标准配方（Radford 等，2021）：
The classification accuracy of CLIP depe.src: The classification accuracy of CLIP depends shockingly on prompt wording. "cat" gets one accuracy; "a photo of a cat" gets ~5 points higher; "a photo of a cat, a type of pet" gets higher again. The standard recipe (Radford et al., 2021):

@@T0@@Prompt ensembling.@@T1@@ Average t.zh: @@T0@@提示集成。@@T1@@ 对 80 个提示模板（「a photo of a {}」「a blurry photo of a {}」「a low-resolution photo of a {}」……）的文本嵌入取平均。可将 ImageNet 零样本准确率提升约 2 个点。
@@T0@@Prompt ensembling.@@T1@@ Average t.src: Prompt ensembling. Average text embeddings across 80 prompt templates ("a photo of a {}", "a blurry photo of a {}", "a low-resolution photo of a {}", …). Bumps ImageNet zero-shot accuracy by ~2 points.

@@T0@@Class-name normalisation.@@T1@@ Us.zh: @@T0@@类别名归一化。@@T1@@ 使用最常见的自然语言形式（用「airplane」而非「aeroplane」，用「ant」而非「Formicidae」）。
@@T0@@Class-name normalisation.@@T1@@ Us.src: Class-name normalisation. Use the most common natural-language form ("airplane" not "aeroplane", "ant" not "Formicidae").

@@T0@@Context-aware prompts.@@T1@@ For m.zh: @@T0@@上下文感知提示。@@T1@@ 对于医学 / 科学领域，添加领域前缀（「a photo of a tissue slide showing {}」）。
@@T0@@Context-aware prompts.@@T1@@ For m.src: Context-aware prompts. For medical / scientific domains, add a domain prefix ("a photo of a tissue slide showing {}").

@@T0@@Soft prompt tuning (CoOp, 2022).@@.zh: @@T0@@软提示微调（CoOp，2022）。@@T1@@ 用可学习的嵌入替换文本模板，在少量带标注样例上拟合。当模板选择是主要不确定性来源时尤为有用。
@@T0@@Soft prompt tuning (CoOp, 2022).@@.src: Soft prompt tuning (CoOp, 2022). Replace the text template with learnable embeddings, fit on a few labelled examples. Useful when the template choice is the dominant uncertainty.

meta.summary: 一个真实的 OpenAI CLIP-ViT-B/32 经由 transformers.js 在你的浏览器中运行。上传一张照片，输入你想要的任意标签，观察模型把两侧都嵌入到共享的 512 维空间，计算真实的余弦相似度，并通过 softmax 转化为实时概率。全程无需微调。
highlights: 加载真实的 OpenAI CLIP-ViT-B/32（经由 transformers.js / ONNX），把你的照片与标签嵌入到共享的 512 维空间。
即时编辑标签；每一次余弦相似度与 softmax 概率都会立即重算。
切换提示模板（「a photo of a {}」「a picture of a {}」或裸标签），观察准确率随之变化。
拖动 softmax 温度滑块，看置信度如何崩塌或趋于平坦。
